title: Hippy commune at at the green house, outer skirts of town
content: So yeah i guess we have a new business growing on the fringe area of mallworld. Bussing in tons of hippies, growing flowers and not sure what else out there. Seems like a bunch of old vehicles have been dumped out there in a row across from the green houses. Its a beautiful place and sparsely wooded area. How much bigger is this city gonna get tho my lord 😬
